prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the services you need. That said, Kansas City has several highly regarded agencies you should consider depending on your priorities:

- Barkley — A large, independent creative agency known for brand strategy and integrated advertising campaigns. Good if you want big creative and national reach.
- VML (VML and VMLY&R have strong Kansas City roots) — Known for digital experience, customer experience transformation, and large-scale digital work for enterprise clients.
- A number of smaller/boutique KC agencies specialize in things like SEO, paid media, social, B2B marketing and branding — and can be better value or a closer cultural fit for mid-market and local businesses.

How to pick the right one
- Define goals and KPIs (brand awareness, lead gen, sales, etc.)
- Match agency strengths to those goals (creative, performance, B2B, digital transformation)
- Evaluate case studies and measurable results in your industry
- Check client references and team structure (who will actually do the work)
- Compare budgets, timelines, and contract terms
- Start with a short pilot project if possible

If you want, tell me:
- What you’re trying to accomplish (services and goals)
- Your industry and budget range
- Whether you prefer a large agency or a boutique/local partner

I’ll give you a tailored shortlist of Kansas City agencies (with quick reasons why each might fit) and suggested questions to ask them.
